title: Ready-made oath confirmation repeats Cost: 10 minutes and $0
body:
Road Warden / Wolf-Winter **ready-made oath confirmation** repeats the same **“Cost: 10 minutes and $0”** line twice in one consequence paragraph.

Grok-4.6 MCP wave: **19** `bugs[]` rows (S0 15 / S1 4). Cosmetic, but it is on the first civic confirmation every player hits.

Fix: emit the cost line once.

Evidence: grok-4.6 instant-thinking wave, 82 completed interviews, build `fe2619a8`.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 MCP wave cluster (19 mentions, 82 completed interviews).
